description: Vendor-neutral core of the Spectree Invoker squad. Single authoritative source: every adapter renders from these files and adds nothing of its own beyond the tokens it declares.

tokens.CARDS_LOCATION: Where an adapter keeps the specialist cards, phrased to read inside a sentence.
tokens.TOOL_SURFACE: The tool surface the harness exposes beyond the CLI, phrased as a trailing clause or empty.
tokens.ROLE_TOOLS: The Tools section body of a role card, which names actual harness tools and is therefore adapter-owned.

extraction_baseline.proved_on: the day the protocol was extracted
extraction_baseline.result: All five specialist cards rendered byte-identical to the files at this revision. CLAUDE.md differed by exactly one line, changed deliberately so the sentence stops naming a Claude-specific directory.
extraction_baseline.note: Historical record. The proof was a one-time gate for the extraction; it is not re-runnable, because the protocol has legitimately evolved since. A command that can never pass again would be decoration.
